module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Errors that can occur during Roman numeral conversion.
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidFormat(text: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(value: 58) is "LVIII"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let mutable result be ""
  let mutable remaining be value

  let values be [1000, 900, 500, 400, 100, 90, 50, 40, 10, 9, 5, 4, 1]
  let numerals be ["M", "CM", "D", "CD", "C", "XC", "L", "XL", "X", "IX", "V", "IV", "I"]

  for each index in from 0 to values.length - 1
    let current_value be values.at(index)
    let current_numeral be numerals.at(index)
    repeat until remaining is less than current_value
      set result to result + current_numeral
      set remaining to remaining - current_value
    end
  end

  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman(text: "LVIII") is 58

  if text.is_empty then
    fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
  end

  let roman_values be {"M": 1000, "D": 500, "C": 100, "L": 50, "X": 10, "V": 5, "I": 1}
  let mutable result be 0
  let mutable previous_value be 0
  let chars be text.characters

  for each index in from chars.length - 1 to 0
    let char be chars.at(index)
    let current_value be roman_values.get(char) otherwise fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)

    if current_value is less than previous_value then
      set result to result - current_value
    otherwise
      set result to result + current_value
    end

    set previous_value to current_value
  end

  if result is less than 1 or result is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
  end

  return result
end

  OutOfRange(value: Integer)

end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(value: 58) is "LVIII"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let mutable result be ""
  let mutable remaining be value

  let values be [1000, 900, 500, 400, 100, 90, 50, 40, 10, 9, 5, 4, 1]
  let numerals be ["M", "CM", "D", "CD", "C", "XC", "L", "XL", "X", "IX", "V", "IV", "I"]

  for each index in from 0 to values.length - 1
    let current_value be values.at(index)

      set result to result + current_numeral

    end
  end

  return result

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman(text: "LVIII") is 58

  if text.is_empty then
    fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
  end

  let upper_text be text.to_upper()
  if not upper_text.matches(raw "^[IVXLCDM]+$") then
    fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
  end

  let roman_values be {"I": 1, "V": 5, "X": 10, "L": 50, "C": 100, "D": 500, "M": 1000}
  let mutable result be 0
  let mutable previous_value be 0

  for each character in upper_text.characters
    let char_text be character
    let current_value be roman_values.get(key: char_text) otherwise fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)

    if current_value is greater than previous_value then
      set result to result + current_value - 2 * previous_value
    otherwise
      set result to result + current_value
    end

    set previous_value to current_value
  end

  if result is less than 1 or result is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
  end

  return result
end
